Mamba &amp; State-Space Models, Visualis.zh: Mamba & 状态空间模型，可视化

A linear recurrence over a hidden state..zh:
一个关于隐藏状态的线性递推。观察它在处理一段
          256 步信号时状态如何演化。切换那个依赖输入的 Δ，
          正是它赋予 Mamba 选择性的优势。
          看清为何 O(N) 才是百万词元级上下文
          应有的复杂度。
A linear recurrence over a hidden state..src:
A linear recurrence over a hidden state. Watch the state
          evolve as it processes a 256-step signal. Toggle the
          input-dependent Δ that gives Mamba its selectivity edge.
          See why O(N) is the right complexity for million-token
          contexts.

@@T0@@~18 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@SSM.zh:
@@T0@@约 18 分钟@@T1@@
          @@T2@@SSM · Mamba · 长上下文@@T3@@

Self-attention is $O(N^2)$ in sequence l.zh:
自注意力在序列长度上的复杂度为 $O(N^2)$。在 1k 词元时
          尚可；在 100k 时已成为主要开销；在 1M 时则
          不可行。状态空间模型（S4、S5、H3、Mamba）
          用线性递推取代注意力，其
          每个词元的开销为 $O(1)$，与序列长度无关。
Self-attention is $O(N^2)$ in sequence l.src:
Self-attention is $O(N^2)$ in sequence length. At 1k tokens
          that's fine; at 100k it's the dominant cost; at 1M it's
          impossible. State-space models (S4, S5, H3, Mamba)
          replace attention with a linear recurrence whose
          per-token cost is $O(1)$ regardless of sequence length.

@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n A dis.zh:
@@T0@@一句口号。@@T1@@
          离散时间 SSM 是一个动力学经过精心选择的
          进阶版 RNN，它让你能通过一次「扫描」并行计算
          许多词元。它保留了 RNN 随长度线性增长的开销，
          同时重新获得了注意力的并行性。
@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n A dis.src: The slogan. A discrete-time SSM is a fancy RNN with carefully chosen dynamics that lets you compute many tokens in parallel via a "scan". It keeps the linear-in-length cost of an RNN and regains the parallelism of attention.

$h_t \\in \\mathbb{R}^d$ is the hidden s.zh:
$h_t \in \mathbb{R}^d$ 是隐藏状态。$\bar A, \bar B$
          是离散化后的动力学；$C$ 是输出投影。
          对 S4 / S5 而言，这些是固定的（或是学习得到但
          与输入无关的）。Mamba 的重大思想是：让 $\bar A, \bar
          B$ 依赖于当前输入 $x_t$。仅此一处改动
          便带来了「选择性」SSM，它能决定哪些输入应当
          继续携带、哪些应当遗忘。
$h_t \\in \\mathbb{R}^d$ is the hidden s.src:
$h_t \in \mathbb{R}^d$ is the hidden state. $\bar A, \bar B$
          are the discretised dynamics; $C$ is the output projection.
          For S4 / S5 these are fixed (or learned but
          input-independent). The big Mamba idea: make $\bar A, \bar
          B$ depend on the current input $x_t$. That single change
          gives "selective" SSMs that can decide which inputs to
          carry forward and which to forget.

Δ is the per-token step size; tiny Δ mea.zh:
Δ 是每个词元的步长；极小的 Δ 意味着「几乎不更新
          状态」（有利于跳过无信息的输入）；较大的
          Δ 意味着「把这个输入视为重要」。二者都是学习得到的。
Δ is the per-token step size; tiny Δ mea.src:
Δ is the per-token step size; tiny Δ means "barely update
          the state" (good for skipping uninformative inputs); large
          Δ means "treat this input as important". Both are learned.

A 1-channel discrete SSM with $A = -0.2$.zh:
一个单通道的离散 SSM，取 $A = -0.2$（缓慢衰减）、$B =
          C = 1$，以及一个 Δ 由你选择：固定不变，或依据输入
          进行调制。下方面板显示 $|h_t|$ 在 256 步
          序列上的变化；上方显示输入。
A 1-channel discrete SSM with $A = -0.2$.src:
A 1-channel discrete SSM with $A = -0.2$ (slow decay), $B =
          C = 1$, and a Δ that you can either fix or modulate from
          the input. The bottom panel shows $|h_t|$ across the 256-step
          sequence; the top shows the input.

Top: input x_t. Bottom: |h_t| (state mag.zh: 上：输入 x_t。下：|h_t|（状态幅度）。采用选择性 Δ 时，状态会忽略低幅度的输入，并锁住稀疏而重要的事件。
Top: input x_t. Bottom: |h_t| (state mag.src: Top: input x_t. Bottom: |h_t| (state magnitude). With selective Δ, the state ignores low-amplitude inputs and latches onto sparse important events.

Cost vs sequence length.zh: 开销与序列长度的关系

Mamba is linear in length; attention is.zh:
Mamba 随长度线性增长；注意力则是二次的。下方：
          两者相对于序列长度的合成运算次数。
          平衡点取决于隐藏宽度，但对任何
          足够长的序列而言，注意力都会落败。
Mamba is linear in length; attention is.src:
Mamba is linear in length; attention is quadratic. Below:
          synthetic operation count for both vs sequence length.
          The break-even point depends on hidden width, but for any
          sufficiently long sequence, attention loses.

Operation counts (log-log). Attention's.zh: 运算次数（双对数坐标）。注意力的 $O(N^2)$ 与 Mamba 扫描的 $O(N \cdot d_{\text{state}})$。
Operation counts (log-log). Attention's.src: Operation counts (log-log). Attention's $O(N^2)$ vs Mamba scan's $O(N \cdot d_{\text{state}})$.

The parallel scan — the trick that makes.zh: 并行扫描 —— 使 SSM 能够大规模训练的技巧
The parallel scan — the trick that makes.src: The parallel scan — the trick that makes SSMs trainable at scale

A linear recurrence $h_t = A h_{t-1} + B.zh:
线性递推 $h_t = A h_{t-1} + B x_t$ @@T0@@看起来@@T1@@
          天生是顺序的—每一步都依赖前一步。RNN 正困在这个
          陷阱里：其训练耗时（墙钟时间）为
          $O(N)$，因为每一层都要等待前一个
          词元的隐藏状态。SSM 通过@@T2@@并行扫描@@T3@@
          摆脱了这一点（Blelloch, 1990；Smith
          等人，2023）：一种可结合的树形归约，
          以 $O(\log N)$ 的深度计算出全部 $h_1, \dots, h_N$。
A linear recurrence $h_t = A h_{t-1} + B.src: A linear recurrence $h_t = A h_{t-1} + B x_t$ looks inherently sequential — each step depends on the previous. RNNs sit in this trap: their training is $O(N)$ wall-clock because each layer waits for the previous token's hidden state. SSMs escape via the parallel scan (Blelloch, 1990; Smith et al., 2023): an associative tree-reduction that computes all $h_1, \dots, h_N$ in $O(\log N)$ depth.

The trick: the operator $(c_1, M_1) \\op.zh:
诀窍在于：算子 $(c_1, M_1) \oplus (c_2, M_2) =
          (M_2 c_1 + c_2,\; M_2 M_1)$ 是可结合的。先将相邻元素
          两两归约，再将相邻元素组的相邻元素两两归约，
          依此类推。每一层都把数量减半；$\log_2 N$ 层
          便完成扫描。在 GPU 上其吞吐可与矩阵乘法相当。
The trick: the operator $(c_1, M_1) \\op.src:
The trick: the operator $(c_1, M_1) \oplus (c_2, M_2) =
          (M_2 c_1 + c_2,\; M_2 M_1)$ is associative. Pair-wise reduce
          neighbours, then pair-wise reduce neighbours-of-neighbours,
          and so on. Each level halves the count; $\log_2 N$ levels
          finish the scan. On a GPU this matches matmul throughput.

Parallel-scan tree for N=8. Step 1 combi.src: Parallel-scan tree for N=8. Step 1 combines (1,2), (3,4), (5,6), (7,8). Step 2 combines (1:2, 3:4) and (5:6, 7:8). Step 3 combines (1:4, 5:8). After log₂N levels, every prefix is computed.

animate sequential RNN comparison.zh: 动画：与顺序 RNN 的对比

Wall-clock depth: sequential RNN is $O(N.zh: 墙钟时间深度：顺序 RNN 为 $O(N)$；并行扫描为 $O(\log N)$。在一段百万词元的上下文上，这意味着 100 万个顺序步骤对 20 个步骤。
Wall-clock depth: sequential RNN is $O(N.src: Wall-clock depth: sequential RNN is $O(N)$; parallel scan is $O(\log N)$. On a 1M-token context that's 1M sequential steps vs 20.

@@T0@@Why this is the SSM superpower.@@T.zh:
@@T0@@为何这是 SSM 的超能力。@@T1@@
          并行扫描是 SSM（S4、S5、Mamba）尽管是递推式的，
          却能训练得像 Transformer 一样快的唯一原因。
          没有它，「随长度线性增长」就只是纸面上的说法。
@@T0@@Why this is the SSM superpower.@@T.src: Why this is the SSM superpower. The parallel scan is the only reason SSMs (S4, S5, Mamba) can train as fast as Transformers despite being recurrent. Without it, "linear in length" stays a paper claim.

@@T0@@Attention wins on:@@T1@@ short seq.zh:
@@T0@@注意力胜出于：@@T1@@ 短序列、
            需要精确长程复制 / 查找的任务、任意模式的上下文内
            学习。大多数 32k 上下文以下的
            LLM 任务。
@@T0@@Attention wins on:@@T1@@ short seq.src: Attention wins on: short sequences, tasks needing exact long-range copy / lookup, in-context learning of arbitrary patterns. Most LLM tasks at sub-32k context.

@@T0@@Mamba wins on:@@T1@@ very long con.zh:
@@T0@@Mamba 胜出于：@@T1@@ 极长的上下文
            （DNA、音频、长文档、时间序列）。线性扩展
            不再只是一个研究细节，而开始成为
            可行与不可行之间的分水岭。
@@T0@@Mamba wins on:@@T1@@ very long con.src: Mamba wins on: very long contexts (DNA, audio, long documents, time series). Linear scaling stops being a research detail and starts being the difference between feasible and not.

@@T0@@Hybrids win:@@T1@@ Mamba-2, Jamba,.zh:
@@T0@@混合架构胜出：@@T1@@ Mamba-2、Jamba、
            Nemotron-H、Zamba 交错堆叠 SSM 层与注意力层，
            胜过了二者各自的纯版本。这是 2026 年的默认选择。
@@T0@@Hybrids win:@@T1@@ Mamba-2, Jamba,.src: Hybrids win: Mamba-2, Jamba, Nemotron-H, Zamba interleave SSM and attention layers and beat the pure variants of either. The 2026 default.

@@T0@@Time-series forecasting.@@T1@@ Mam.zh:
@@T0@@时间序列预测。@@T1@@ Mamba 与 S5
            目前在长预测跨度上与 PatchTST 互有胜负。
            对于跨越数年、以小时 / 分钟为
            分辨率的数据，这是天然的骨干网络。
@@T0@@Time-series forecasting.@@T1@@ Mam.src: Time-series forecasting. Mamba and S5 currently trade blows with PatchTST on long horizons. For data with hour / minute resolution stretching across years, this is the natural backbone.

@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n T.zh:
@@T0@@最终要点。@@T1@@
          理解 SSM 的正确方式是把它看作「一个特征值经过精心调校、
          对并行友好的 RNN」。在此基础上理解 Mamba 的正确方式是
          「SSM 可以在决定更新多少之前先看看它的输入」。
          二者结合，在不牺牲训练速度的前提下
          移除了上下文长度上的 $N^2$ 天花板。
@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n T.src: Final takeaway. The right way to think of an SSM is "a parallel-friendly RNN with hand-tuned eigenvalues". The right way to think of Mamba on top is "the SSM gets to look at its input before deciding how much to update". Together they remove the $N^2$ ceiling on context length without sacrificing training speed.

meta.title: Mamba 与状态空间模型，可视化
meta.tagline: 一个随序列长度线性扩展的 RNN —— 在长上下文上胜过注意力
meta.summary: 离散时间 SSM 是一种线性递推。观察一个单通道 SSM 的状态在处理一段 256 步输入时如何演化；切换赋予 Mamba 关键优势的选择性 Δ 参数；在同一序列上与注意力的二次开销作比较。
highlights: 在 256 步输入上实时运行离散时间 SSM 前向传播；状态值与输入并排绘制。
选择性 Δ 滑块 —— Mamba 依赖输入的步长，把静态 SSM 变为对内容敏感的 SSM。
开销-长度曲线：O(N) 的 Mamba 扫描与 O(N²) 的注意力。
SSM 何时胜出、注意力何时胜出、混合架构身处何处。
